catenaShort: Quoted verbatim from the Church Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church — chiefly Blessed Theophylact of Ohrid and St Bede, then St Augustine, St John Chrysostom and others. Each quotation above names its own Father and the homily or work it is drawn from.
catenaLong: The patristic commentary quoted throughout is drawn from the Church Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church, led by Blessed Theophylact of Ohrid and St Bede, then St Augustine, St John Chrysostom, St Jerome, St Gregory the Dialogist, St Hilary, St Cyril of Alexandria, St Ambrose and St Leo — quoted verbatim, nothing paraphrased and nothing invented; each quotation names its own Father and the homily or work it comes from. Material later identified as spuriously attributed to St Chrysostom (much of it actually Victor of Antioch’s) or to St Jerome is excluded throughout.
